component.name: Shenzhen PDF
component.summary: Fast tabbed PDF reader with on-device OCR

description.p: Shenzhen PDF is a fast, keyboard-friendly PDF and e-book reader. It opens documents in tabs, restores your session across launches, and keeps the first page on screen in a fraction of a second.

ul.li: Tabbed reading with session restore, recents and favorites
Instant search with regex support and a document minimap
On-device OCR for scanned documents — no cloud, no account
Outline sidebar, page thumbnails and a command palette
Comments and annotations, printing, and rotation that saves in place
Reads PDF, XPS, EPUB, MOBI, CBZ/CBR and FictionBook files

screenshot.caption: Reading a document with the outline sidebar and tab bar

description.p: Compact Mac-style sidebar pane switcher and row spacing, window close now exits the whole app with full session restore on relaunch, and state files are compatible with the macOS app.

UI parity fixes: always-visible tab row, document view clipping, minimap toggle, fit-height mode, fit-mode dropdown, page-step buttons, sidebar chapter/comment filtering, and reliable chapter navigation.
GTK4 Linux release with tabbed reading, search, OCR, offline translation, annotations and printing.
